_comment: Track 30: hand-authored demo dialogue. Bully keeps dialogue audio in XACT banks and script in .lur bytecode (both deferred/unparseable), so content mimics the game's flavor. Trees are selected per NPC by model index (Engine: npcModelIndex % tree count); 'voice' paths are placeholders for the deferred wav hookup.

greeting.speaker: Student
lines: Oh. Hey. You're the new kid, right?
Word travels fast around here. Mostly because Gary talks.

choices.text: So what's the deal with this school?

school.speaker: Student
lines: It's Bullworth. Rules are more like... suggestions.
Keep your head down in class, watch your back in the yard.
And whatever you do, don't step on the prefect's shoes.

gary.speaker: Student
lines: Gary? Gary Smith. Wheelchair-evil, allegedly walking now.
He'll call you 'friend' and mean 'minion'.
Do his errands if you want. Just don't turn your back.

farewell.speaker: Student
lines: Catch you around, new kid.
Try not to end up in the headmaster's office on day one.

greeting.speaker: Prefect
lines: Halt. I don't recognize you.
That uniform says 'new enrollment'. That face says 'trouble'.

choices.text: Where can a guy get a soda around here?

innocent.speaker: Prefect
lines: 'Sir.' I like that. Respect is rare in this school.
Stay clean, keep moving, and we won't have a problem.
Break one rule and I'll be faster than you think.

soda.speaker: Prefect
lines: Vending machine by the gym. It eats quarters, not students.
And no, I will not write you a hall pass for it.

farewell.speaker: Prefect
lines: Move along. And walk, don't run.

greeting.speaker: Bully
lines: Well, well. Fresh meat walks right up to ME.
You lost, new kid? Or just stupid?

tough.speaker: Bully
lines: Ha! Big words from a little transfer.
Tell you what: survive the yard at lunch, and we'll talk.
Till then, scram before I get bored.

pass.speaker: Bully
lines: Passing through MY hallway?
Toll's a dollar. Or your lunch. Or a black eye. Dealer's choice.

shoelace.speaker: Bully
lines: What? No way, I double-knotted th---
...You almost got me. Okay. You're funny, new kid. Funny keeps you alive here.

farewell.speaker: Bully
lines: Get outta here before I change my mind.

greeting.speaker: Nerd
lines: Whoa! You startled me. I'm calibrating the telescope mount.
You're the new student! Fascinating. What's your GPA?

choices.text: How do I stay out of trouble here?
Forget it. I don't speak nerd.

project.speaker: Nerd
lines: A radio telescope! Well... a broken satellite dish and hope.
Last week I picked up the cafeteria radio. Progress!
The jocks threw my last one off the roof. Twice.

advice.speaker: Nerd
lines: Statistically? Avoid hallways between 12:05 and 12:15.
That's when the bullies optimize for ambush density.
Also, befriending the shop teacher helps. He owns a kiln.

choices.text: Good luck with the dish thing.

farewell.speaker: Nerd
lines: Thanks! If you hear strange beeps at night, that's us. Not aliens.
...Probably not aliens.
